name: Bagus Tattoo Studio
summary: A characterful tattoo studio company profile with a flash design catalogue, style filters, artist profiles, indicative pricing and a multi-step WhatsApp enquiry.
included: Tattoo flash catalogue with category filters
WhatsApp handoff with selected design and enquiry summary
customisable: Brand name, logo, colours and typography
Phone, WhatsApp, email, address and opening hours
Flash designs, styles, artists and prices
Gallery images and image crop positions

asset_guidance.hero: Landscape or portrait studio / tattoo photograph, minimum 1600px wide
asset_guidance.flash_gallery: Portrait artwork images, ideally 4:5 and 1000px on the long edge

notes: Bagus Tattoo Studio, artists, address, contact details, hours and prices are illustrative concept content.
Gallery imagery is remote demonstration imagery and must be replaced with client-owned or properly licensed portfolio images before commercial launch.
Displayed flash designs and prices are sample concepts and indicative only; availability and final quotes require studio confirmation.
Booking is front-end only. It prepares a WhatsApp enquiry and does not store appointments, check availability, process deposits or confirm sessions.
Replace the sample WhatsApp number and all illustrative business details before publishing for a real business.
